title: Low-Level Design (Firmware Workflow)

node_notes.render: When the display is ready, display_process advances splash or dashboard rendering using the current snapshot. The call is in the app_start loop after event and LED handling.
node_notes.telemetry: The application calls telemetry_process with the current time, readings, and event every loop; the service itself enforces the configured record period. The call is at the end of the app_start iteration.
node_notes.event_output: When the event changes, the application updates display text and logs either a cleared event or the selected event message. These calls are grouped under the change condition in app_start.
node_notes.start: This step starts FirmGen telemetry and initializes app-local state before hardware setup. The calls are at the beginning of app_start in firmware/app/app.c.
node_notes.init: This branch checks whether platform_io_init completed successfully. app_start returns immediately on failure rather than entering the sensor and display loop.
node_notes.accel_gate: The branch selects a real acceleration sample when acceleration_valid is true and otherwise supplies NULL. That validity check appears in the event-processing block of app_start.
node_notes.display_ready: The application checks whether display initialization succeeded before processing display state. A failed display initialization therefore skips recurring display work.
node_notes.led: The application sends the current alert LED state to the platform layer on each loop iteration. The call is platform_io_led in firmware/app/app.c.
node_notes.poll: Each cooperative-loop iteration polls FirmGen telemetry, reads the tick count, and polls platform I/O. This is the first recurring work in app_start's loop.
node_notes.led_log: The application logs whether the LED command changed to ON or OFF, then records the new previous state. This conditional logging follows the LED state comparison.
node_notes.event_gate: This decision prevents repeated event-change display updates and logs. It compares the current event with previous_event in app_start.
node_notes.display_gate: Ride-event sampling and updating only happen when the display initialized successfully and is no longer showing its splash. The condition is checked in app_start before event processing.
node_notes.failed: An I/O initialization failure ends app_start before any runtime polling begins. The early return is in firmware/app/app.c directly after platform_io_init.
node_notes.process: The sensor service updates scheduled sensor readings and app_start obtains the resulting snapshot. The calls are sensors_process and sensors_snapshot in firmware/app/app.c.
node_notes.update: The ride-event module selects the active event and computes the LED state for the current time. app_start calls ride_events_update after submitting the sample.
node_notes.setup: On success, app_start scans the I2C bus, initializes the display and sensors, and initializes ride-event state. These setup calls occur before the infinite loop in firmware/app/app.c.
node_notes.sample: The application submits either the snapshot's acceleration and timestamp or an invalid sample to ride_events_sample. Both paths are present in firmware/app/app.c.
node_notes.led_gate: This check detects transitions in the requested LED state so the application logs only changes. It compares led_on to previous_led in app_start.
